changelog.change: Initial generation for price-book real-world pipeline test

entries.aggregation_description: Single-entity pass-through; Price Book is already a coherent top-level UI concept — list + CRUD detail form, no cross-entity aggregation needed at this level
Combines PriceCategory with its parent PriceBook (for the filter/context dropdown) into one coherent 'manage categories for a selected book' view

Combines PriceHeader with its PriceBook and PriceCategory ancestors (for cascading filters) into one coherent 'manage hierarchical headers under a selected book/category' view. Includes the PriceHeader's own self-referential parent/child structure.

Combines PriceItem with its full ancestor chain (PriceBook, PriceCategory, PriceHeader) for cascading filters, into one coherent 'manage actual price records under a selected book/category/header' view
